title: Absolute maximum at an endpoint
statement:
Find the absolute maximum value of $(x-[$a])^2$ on $[0,2([$a])+1]$.

[__________]{a}
hints: Compare endpoint distances from the center.
The right endpoint lies one unit farther away.
solution: The two endpoint values are $[$a]^2$ and $([$a]+1)^2$. The latter is larger.

feedback.message: The right endpoint lies one unit farther away.
